Hi Sam / Finvero audit team,

Thanks for the list of evidence items. Quick summary of what Redwood can provide for audit/access logs and a few clarifying questions so we scope the export correctly:

- Retention defaults: tenant-level access/audit traces are kept 90 days by default for hosted plans. We offer configurable retention windows up to 7 years on Dedicated/Private plans via the console or API.
- Export formats: exports are delivered as gzipped NDJSON (one event per line) or parquet snapshots on request. For very large windows we slice into ~24-48 hour chunks to keep files manageable.
- Delivery methods: signed S3 POST, Google Cloud signed URLs, or SFTP for air-gapped customers. Exports include an index manifest with checksum and time ranges.
- Deletion proof: we can provide a manifest showing tombstoned record IDs plus a signed statement of deletion for tenant-scoped data; full forensic erasure on on-prem installs is performed by ops playbook.

Questions:
1) Is Finvero asking for a rolling export (e.g., daily snapshots for the past 365 days) or a one-off bulk handover for legal hold?
2) Do you need a preservation copy in-region (US-East) only, or cross-region slices?
3) Any specific schema mapping required for your SIEM (Splunk/QRadar)? We map fields in the manifest but can include a column mapping CSV.

Attaching the export spec and the evidence request you sent so I can point to exact rows.

Next steps: once you confirm the scope (days, in-region vs cross-region, delivery method) we’ll provide an export run ETA and a tamper-evident manifest.

Thanks,

Hey team,

Technical answers below — I’ve flagged items that need Security/legal sign-off:

1) Deletion attestation: we produce an attest document post-delete for tenant-scoped handovers. It includes a signed manifest (SHA256 of each exported file), list of object keys removed, and a timestamped statement from Redwood’s Data Compliance team. Ops runs the erasure job which records a tombstone ledger entry per object. Security needs to sign the attest; Legal should confirm language.

2) Tombstones and merges: exports include the raw event stream when requested (raw mode) which preserves tombstone markers and pre-merge identifiers. By default (summary mode) we output the current merged view to reduce size. For legal hold, we should supply raw mode. Note: raw mode increases export size ~2-3x.

3) Chunking/throughput: for 24 months we recommend chunking by 48-hour slices; estimated total size ~2.1 TB raw (depends on sequence). We can stream directly to your signed S3 bucket at ~300 MB/s aggregate if you provide credentials and ACL.

4) Cost/ETA: rough engineering ETA 5 business days to schedule + 2 business days for a full run (dependent on queue). Egress estimate: $X,XXX (S3 egress + packaging). I’ll get a precise quote once we lock scope.

Action items:
- Kimberly: please draft the deletion attestation template and loop in Legal.
- Olga: once Finvero confirms signed S3 destination, share the bucket and permission method.
- Security: confirm willingness to sign the attest and the standard text.

Rishi
